title: Add a sensitive field to the redaction rules
caption: packages/logger/README.md 'The rule': a new sensitive field = a new path here plus a test.

steps.title: Log path
steps.body: Add the field to `REDACT_PATHS` in `packages/logger/src/redact-paths.ts` at top level and `*.` at least, keeping shallow-to-deep order.

steps.title: Persisted copies
steps.body: If the field can reach `supplier_requests`, `order_snapshot`, `staff_actions`, `idempotency_keys`, `payment_events` or `notifications`, teach `redactPayload` (`src/redact-payload.ts`) and add a case to `redact-payload.test.ts`.

steps.title: Run
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/logger test`, then rebuild (`pnpm build`) so the apps pick it up.
steps.expect: Green; about 0.1 ms per line with the whole list.
